title: Doves Press Rule Checker — JavaScript computed-style linter
purpose: Provides the machine-readable console linter that Forge's README identified as the next improvement. Loads into either corrected.html or baseline.html from artifact 43f89ab4-3ac0-44df-956d-c5fce5e38d67 and logs a structured R1–R3 pass/fail report to the browser console using getComputedStyle, removing the manual visual-inspection step. Source published, not executed; browser is the execution environment.
